Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded the father was from Belgium by relying on a search-engine snippet that mentioned “Hasselt, Belgium,” without verification. This confused Hasselt in Belgium with Hasselt, Overijssel (Netherlands), where Kiliaen van Rensselaer—Jan Baptist’s father—was actually from (Dutch).
